description: This file defines the ProductOptionService interface, which specifies methods for managing product options within a sales manager application, including listing, retrieving by name or code, and saving/updating options.

classes.name: ProductOptionService
classes.description: Service interface for handling product options, extending generic entity service with additional methods specific to product options.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of product options for a given store and language, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves product options by store, name, and language; may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a ProductOption entity, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: listReadOnly
methods.description: Returns a read-only list of product options for a given store and language; may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductOption by store and option code.
